messages:
naomi.partnerships: Heads-up: NebulaStack's marketplace mapping went out with region aliasing reversed (us-east -> us-central). Their reservations auto-bound to us-east-1 and that depleted our US-Central Dedicated buffer. Caught during commit reconciliation. :frowning:
ben.ops: I see it. Allocation churn shows partner_region_alias: us-central mapped to us-east in the manifest. This caused ~12 reserved slots to move. I can throttle new partner allocations while we get partner to republish.
sam.logistics: We have 3 warm racks in US-central staging but they're tagged for another launch. Swapping them will take 4h for reprovision + cert rotation. Could be a viable stopgap.
rachel.sales: Two customers in the queue (EdTechOne, HealthMapper) expect reserves by tomorrow. If we shift racks we must coordinate account comms and credits. Partnership to own comms?
ben.ops: Ops quick command (permissions required):
```
redwoodctl partners pause --partner nebulastack --region us-east-1 --reason "region-alias-mismatch"
```
That stops further partner allocations into the wrong region. I'll queue it pending approvals.
neo-bot: approval-needed: pause request by ben.ops for partner nebulastack; approve with `approve-bot 8792` in channel.
naomi.partnerships: @ben.ops please wait 20m for partner confirmation. I'll ping NebulaStack rep now and request corrected manifest. @sam.logistics please estimate swap timeline and cost for reprovisioning.
ben.ops: Partner responded: they acknowledged alias bug and will push corrected manifest in ~18m. They requested we avoid pausing so their customers don't see failures in the marketplace.
sam.logistics: Swap estimate: 4.5h including certs and routing. If we do a hot-move (network-level) we can cut it to ~3h but higher risk. Cost: approx 3 reserved rack-hours cross-region labor + express freight if needed.
rachel.sales: If partner fixes manifest in 18m, we can avoid customer-facing migration. I'll prepare holding note offering 3% credit if reserve window slips. Need final copy if we go to customers.
naomi.partnerships: OK we'll wait for partner patch. If no manifest update by +20m @ben.ops run the pause. Also prep contingency steps: 1) sam pre-stage swap manifest, 2) ben plan allocation reconcile to revert misallocated slots, 3) rachel prepare customer advisory.
ben.ops: Noted. Setting a watcher and reconcile job ready:
```
redwoodctl allocations reconcile --region us-central --partner nebulastack --dry-run
```
Will run dry-run first then reconcile if safe.
neo-bot: partner-notice: NebulaStack manifest publish queued (manifest id nb-9876) at 2026-03-22T14:12Z.
naomi.partnerships: Partner says manifest live. Ben, can you run reconcile and confirm capacity freed? Sam keep swap on standby but don't ship yet. Rachel, hold draft until we confirm.
ben.ops: Running dry-run reconcile now, output shows 11 stale misallocated reservations that would free ~22% of the us-central pool. Proceeding to apply reconcile.
neo-bot: action: reconcile job executed by ben.ops; job id r-2591234567-1.
ben.ops: Reconcile complete. Freed 11 reservations, pool back to normal. Saved audit at /logs/reconcile/2591234567.csv. No customer allocations were dropped.
sam.logistics: Great. I'll cancel the swap cargo hold and put racks back in warm state.
rachel.sales: Draft ready but holding. I'll only send if customers ask. Offering 3% credit as pre-approved.
naomi.partnerships: Closing loop: 1) NebulaStack fixed manifest. 2) Ops reconciled and freed capacity. 3) Logistics on standby but no swap needed. 4) Sales holds comms unless customers escalate. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
